via: Transcribed by hand from the published tier bonus table; unlike the other captures here it was not read out of the page, which the scraper could not reach.
note: Qantas Points only. Status Credits take no tier bonus, and neither currency takes one on a partner-marketed sector -- the bonus is a Qantas-flight benefit.

appliesOn.reading: A Qantas flight number. Qantas describes the bonus as applying to eligible Qantas and Jetstar flights, which is how every other row of its earning tables is selected; an Explorer fare cannot be flown on Jetstar as the marketing carrier, so QF is the whole of it here.
